title: Analytic toolkit (compactly vanishing IM representations, Hadamard and frame action bounds, Lipschitz-preserving mollification, smooth cut-offs) and the Lipschitz push-forward operator on compactly vanishing IM currents (Simon 2.29, 3.9)
statement: Conventions: ℝ^N = Euclid N and Hᵈ = μHE[d]. 𝒟^d(U) = TestFormOn U d (smooth d-forms with compact support in U) and 𝒟_d(U) = GeometricCurrentOn U d; ∂X = X.boundary; X − Y is pointwise on test forms. |α| = covectorEuclideanNorm α is the Euclidean coefficient norm of a covector and ‖·‖ is the operator norm. M_W(X) = X.massOn W and M(X) = X.mass = M_univ(X). An IMRep R = (M, θ, ξ) (contract structure IMRep U d) has μ_R = θ·Hᵈ⌞M = R.measure and R.action(γ) = ∫_M θ ξ(γ) dHᵈ for any d-form γ; X is IM if some IMRep represents it. X vanishes off E if X(ω) = 0 whenever tsupport ω is disjoint from E. For a map Φ and a form ω, Φ^#ω(x) := ω(Φ(x)) ∘ DΦ(x) (Lean (ω (Φ x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ Φ x)). (i) Let P, k ∈ ℕ. Let X ∈ 𝒟_k(ℝ^P) (domain univ) be represented by an IMRep R = (M, θ, ξ) in univ, and let E ⊆ ℝ^P be compact with X vanishing off E. Then H^k(M ∖ E) = 0, M(X) = μ_R(ℝ^P) and μ_R(ℝ^P) ≠ ∞. Moreover R.action(γ) = R.action(γ') for all k-forms γ, γ' (arbitrary functions ℝ^P → Λ^k) with γ = γ' on E. (ii) (Hadamard) For all N, m ∈ ℕ, every m-covector α on ℝ^N and all v_1, …, v_m ∈ ℝ^N: |α(v_1, …, v_m)| ≤ |α|·∏_i‖v_i‖. (iii) Let R = (M, θ, ξ) be an IMRep of degree k in any U ⊆ ℝ^P with μ_R(ℝ^P) ≠ ∞, let γ be any k-form and c ≥ 0. Assume that for H^k-a.e. x ∈ M, |γ(x)(τ_1, …, τ_k)| ≤ c for every orthonormal family τ in ℝ^P. Then |R.action(γ)| ≤ c·μ_R(ℝ^P) (real number via ENNReal.toReal). (iv) For all N, N' ∈ ℕ, Λ ∈ ℝ≥0 and every Λ-Lipschitz F : ℝ^N → ℝ^{N'} there are C^∞ (ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞)) Λ-Lipschitz maps F_j : ℝ^N → ℝ^{N'} (j ∈ ℕ) with F_j → F uniformly on ℝ^N. (v) For every compact E ⊆ ℝ^P there are a C^∞ function χ : ℝ^P → ℝ with compact support and 0 ≤ χ ≤ 1, and an open W ⊇ E with χ = 1 on W. (vi) (Push-forward operator.) Assume (IPF), the conclusion of the frozen statement of dor_lmb_fcd_im_pushforward, which the parent obtains by applying that declaration to the antecedent (IMS). (IPF) says the following. Let N, N', k ∈ ℕ and let R be an IMRep of degree k in univ ⊆ ℝ^N with μ_R(ℝ^N) ≠ ∞. Then there is Y : (ℝ^N → ℝ^{N'}) → 𝒟_k(ℝ^{N'}) with two properties. (a) For every Λ ∈ ℝ≥0 and every Λ-Lipschitz F, Y(F) is IM. Moreover, for every sequence of C¹ Λ-Lipschitz maps F_j → F uniformly and every ω ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^{N'}), R.action(F_j^#ω) → Y(F)(ω). (b) Y(F) = Y(F') whenever F, F' are Λ-Lipschitz and F = F' H^k⌞R.carrier-a.e. Then for every P ∈ ℕ there is an operation push : ∀ k, (ℝ^P → ℝ^P) → 𝒟_k(ℝ^P) → 𝒟_k(ℝ^P) with the following property. Let k ∈ ℕ, Λ ∈ ℝ≥0, F Λ-Lipschitz, E ⊆ ℝ^P compact, and X ∈ 𝒟_k(ℝ^P) IM and vanishing off E. Then: (P1) push k F X is IM. (P2) push k F X = push k F' X for every Λ-Lipschitz F' with F = F' on E. (P3) Let F_j be C¹ Λ-Lipschitz maps with F_j → F uniformly on ℝ^P, let ω ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^P), and let η_j ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^P) be test forms with η_j(x) = F_j^#ω(x) for all x ∈ E. Then X(η_j) → push k F X(ω). (P4) M(push k F X) ≤ Λ^k·M(X). (P5) push k F X vanishes off F(E). The Lean statement is the conjunction (i) ∧ (ii) ∧ (iii) ∧ (iv) ∧ (v) ∧ ((IPF) → (vi)).
